title: The Orbit of New Lagos Anew
author: Edmund Nystrom
blurb: Lior Hartwell, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
